name: oci-architecture-diagram
description: Generate portable HTML/SVG architecture diagrams for Oracle Cloud Infrastructure from natural-language prompts.

interface.shortDescription: Create OCI diagrams and open them in Codex Browser via localhost.
interface.longDescription: Turns natural-language Oracle Cloud architecture descriptions into normalized diagram specs, renders self-contained HTML/SVG output, serves the local gallery over localhost, and uses the Codex Browser as the final visual delivery surface.
defaultPrompt: Dibuja una arquitectura web en OCI con OKE y Autonomous Database.
Create an OCI architecture diagram for a public web app.
Generate an HTML OCI diagram from this architecture description.
